test_simple_imputer: test SimpleImputer with mean, median, most_frequent, and constant strategies on dense and sparse arrays
test_iterative_imputer: test IterativeImputer with multiple estimators, clipping, and truncated normal posterior sampling
test_knn_imputer: test KNNImputer with keep_empty_features parameter on arrays with missing values
test_missing_indicator: test MissingIndicator to generate boolean masks for missing values in dense and sparse matrices
test_imputation_pipeline: test SimpleImputer within a scikit-learn Pipeline with GridSearchCV for hyperparameter tuning
